# 3. Imperial Roads Tier 9: Early Steam Railway Terminus (1775+, city/megalopolis, max_levels = 1).
# High construction cost (expensive + Age VI price + steel/coal/steam-engine demand); provides regional
# proximity anchor, market access, and supply hub synergizing natively with Imperial Roads (0 edits to oe_road_*).
oe_stm_early_steam_railway_depot = {
	audio_tier = 6
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 1
	category = infrastructure_category
	employment_size = large_burgher_employment
	town = no
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	expensive = yes
	price = p_expensive_building_age_6_revolutions
	build_time = 900
	graphical_tags = { factory_large }
	construction_demand = oe_stm_railway_depot_construction
	country_potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1775
			has_variable = oe_stm_railway_program_active
		}
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			development >= 25
			is_capital = yes
			is_market_center = yes
			owner ?= { has_variable = oe_stm_railway_program_active }
		}
	}
	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_stm_pm_railway_depot_maint = {
			icon_type = goods
			icon = oe_steam_engines
			coal = 0.45
			steel = 0.25
			oe_steam_engines = 0.20
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				location = { has_owner = yes }
			}
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_stm_railway_depots_built } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_stm_railway_depots_built value = 0 }
				}
				change_variable = { name = oe_stm_railway_depots_built add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		local_proximity_source = 45
		local_market_access = 0.20
		local_supply_limit_modifier = 0.35
		local_merchant_capacity = 0.60
		local_trade_center_power = 0.15
		local_monthly_development_modifier = 0.10
		local_construction_speed = 0.15
		local_institution_growth_modifier = 0.15
	}
}
